Sandbox_RT_BuyPriceMultiplier_tooltip: Price multiplier for duffel bags and supplies purchased over the radio. (Default: 2.0x)
Sandbox_RT_SellPriceMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier for credits earned when selling items via the drop box. (Default: 1.0x)
Sandbox_RT_TradeFrequency_tooltip: Radio frequency used for the trading network. (Default: 104.8 MHz)
Sandbox_RT_RequireOutdoorLZ_tooltip: When enabled, only outdoor containers can be designated as trading LZs.
Sandbox_RT_LZMaxRange_tooltip: Maximum distance between player and LZ container for registration.
Sandbox_RT_DeliveryTimeHours_tooltip: In-game hours between order dispatch and helicopter supply drop.
Sandbox_RT_HeliHordeEnabled_tooltip: Whether a trailing zombie horde spawns as the transport helicopter approaches.
Sandbox_RT_HeliHordeSize_tooltip: Size of the zombie horde spawned near the approach vector.
Sandbox_RT_HeliZombieAttractRadius_toolt: Radius within which existing zombies are attracted by helicopter rotor noise.
Sandbox_RT_MegaHordeChance_tooltip: Chance for an incoming delivery to trigger a high-danger Mega Horde (2.5x zombie count and expanded acoustic wave).
Sandbox_RT_HeliHordeRemoteRatio_tooltip: Controls the ratio of trailing zombies that march in as virtual hordes from distant unloaded cells along the flight path versus spawning directly near the LZ. (Default: Remote Only 100%%)
Sandbox_RT_DroneDeliveryCost_tooltip: Additional fee charged when ordering via silent stealth drone (no trailing horde, acoustic waves suppressed). (Default: 200 CR)
Sandbox_RT_HeliHordeSprinterChance_toolt: Chance for trailing zombies spawned during helicopter events to be fast sprinters, even in shambler-only sandbox worlds. (Default: None 0%%)
Sandbox_RT_RequireFlyerToUnlock_tooltip: When enabled, radio trade menus are completely hidden until you find and read the handwritten note 'Scavengers Wanted!' from zombie loot or foraging. When disabled, the trade menu is available from the start. (Default: Enabled)
Sandbox_RT_FlyerMinSurvivedDays_tooltip: Minimum number of days survived before the Scavenger Flyer can spawn on zombies or via foraging. Set to 0 to enable from day one. (Default: 5 days)
